fact: On 5 October 2026 the Northern State information centre director said the Wafi resource-management system, in use since 2017 and stopped in 2023 by the war, is being restored, salary and accounts data have been updated since August, and the new year budget will be run through it.
title: أمين عام حكومة الشمالية يبحث استعادة أنظمة وزارة المالية وتعزيز التحول الرقمي
